The Top 5 AgriTech Startup Hubs are in London, Bangalore, Singapore, Hyderabad & New York City. Several platforms maintain comprehensive agritech startup directories:

## Precision Agriculture Innovations

Notable startups develop solutions for early-stage plant disease detection, poultry biosecurity, crop mapping, and more. Some specific examples include:

- Orchard Robotics builds an AI-powered operating system that enables precision agriculture for fruit growers using advanced camera systems for real-time crop data

Here are the key findings from the web search on agrotech companies in 2026:

## Market Overview

There are 29,786 companies in AgriTech, with 6,317 funded companies and 2,194 having secured Series A funding. The sector has seen the creation of 18 Unicorns to date. The United States has the most number of AgriTech companies (7,579), followed by India (5,115) and the United Kingdom (1,740).

## Leading Companies

Innova Feed, Farmers Business Network and Chestnut Carbon lead the 2026 ranking. AGRIVI and Arable lead in farm management and real-time field analytics, while OneSoil brings satellite-powered crop monitoring at scale. Indigo has raised $1.4B to improve farming sustainability.

## Technology Focus

These companies focus on using AI, IoT sensors, and data analytics to deliver real-time insights, and are building real-world solutions across AI, IoT, robotics, and analytics to improve productivity and sustainability in agriculture. Orchard Robotics builds an AI-powered operating system that enables precision agriculture for fruit growers, using advanced camera systems to provide farmers with real-time data on crop development and yield.

## Funding and Growth

The 60 top-ranked agritech companies have raised $7.5B between them. The leading hubs are New York, Cambridge and London.
